notes.content: Students may choose from two Biology pathways. The first is compatible with the AA-T in Kinesiology for options in Dance and Sport Studies: General Biology/Lab Human Anatomy/Laboratory Studies in Human Anatomy OR Human Anatomy for Health Sciences/Laboratory Studies in Human Anatomy Human Physiology OR Recommended for students interested in pursuing graduate study in allied health-related programs such as physical therapy or medicine. This pathway is not compatible with the AA-T in Kinesiology since students may exceed 60 units after transfer to complete all requirements for the B.S. degree. Combined Anatomy and Physiology I and II course sequence from community college may be approved to substitute for Human Anatomy & Physiology I/Lab and Human Anatomy & Physiology II/ Lab : Biological Principles I/Biology Laboratory I Biological Principles II/Biology Laboratory II Human Anatomy & Physiology I/Lab Human Anatomy & Physiology II/Lab
notes.contentHtml:
Students may choose from two Biology pathways. The first is compatible with the AA-T in Kinesiology for options in Dance and Sport Studies:


  • General Biology/Lab
  • Human Anatomy/Laboratory Studies in Human Anatomy OR Human Anatomy for Health Sciences/Laboratory Studies in Human Anatomy
  • Human Physiology


OR


Recommended for students interested in pursuing graduate study in allied health-related programs such as physical therapy or medicine. This pathway is not compatible with the AA-T in Kinesiology since students may exceed 60 units after transfer to complete all requirements for the B.S. degree. Combined Anatomy and Physiology I and II course sequence from community college may be approved to substitute for Human Anatomy & Physiology I/Lab and Human Anatomy & Physiology II/ Lab:


  • Biological Principles I/Biology Laboratory I
  • Biological Principles II/Biology Laboratory II
  • Human Anatomy & Physiology I/Lab
  • Human Anatomy & Physiology II/Lab
